projects.name: MTL 1
projects.quote: Through Enovum, we lease and operate a 4MW AI data center located in Montreal, Canada (“MTL 1”).

projects.name: MTL 2
projects.quote: On December 27, 2024, we announced that we had acquired the real estate and building for a build-to-suit 5MW Tier-3 data center expansion project in Montreal (“MTL 2”).

projects.name: Enovum Data Centers Corp acquisition
projects.quote: On October 11, 2024, we significantly expanded our HPC data center operations and capabilities by acquiring Enovum Data Centers Corp (“Enovum”), a Tier-3 HPC data center platform based in Montreal, Canada.

projects.name: BlöndUos Campus
projects.quote: Our initial HPC data center partnership through which we lease capacity is at BlöndUos Campus, Iceland, offering a world-class operations team with certified technicians and reliable engineers.
